summary.text: Alicia Rule is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 42-Position 1, where she has served since January 2021, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a social worker and owner of a mental health practice.

paragraphs.text: Alicia Rule earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington and a master's degree from San Diego State University.
Her career experience includes working as a social worker and owning a mental health practice.
She took office in the Washington House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Luanne Van Werven.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as the Capital Budget Committee and the Human Services, Youth, & Early Learning Committee.
